# PEM certificate viewer

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/certificate-viewer/

Inspect a public X.509 certificate’s names, dates, key details and fingerprint. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Paste a public PEM certificate to inspect subject, issuer, validity dates and a SHA-256 fingerprint.

## Limits and checks

Viewing a certificate does not verify its trust chain, revocation status or ownership. Do not paste private keys or other secrets.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [Peculiar Ventures — X.509 parsing library](https://github.com/PeculiarVentures/x509)
